documents.unit: Center for Teaching Excellence and Innovation
documents.title: Your Classroom Faculty Guide to AI
documents.quality_note: Teaching-center guide: tells faculty to set clear expectations and require AI use disclosures and citations, with detection and 'reduce AI vulnerability' sections. Advisory, not a binding policy; much text is generic best-practice prose.

notes: Health-sciences university with no computing unit. Searches for a Rush-wide student AI policy or college-level policy returned nothing from Rush; only the CTEI guide found.
